modules.name: Aver.Anim
modules.description: Samples .ocanim clips into poses and poses a skeleton; needs no RHI.

modules.name: Aver.Anim.Abi
modules.description: Plain-C seam onto property-track animation so Aver.Fabric's AnimationPlayer drives it.

modules.name: Aver.Anim.Scene
modules.description: The join between the scene and the animation sampler: animation components, control rig, notifies.
modules.consequence: Entities in a scene are not animated: no skeletal animation, control rig or animation notifies.

modules.name: Aver.Assets
modules.description: Asset registry plus Aver.Assets.Gpu, the decode-to-GPU join.

modules.name: Aver.Audio
modules.description: Device-free audio mixer that renders into a buffer the caller supplies.

modules.name: Aver.Audio.Abi
modules.description: Plain-C seam onto the audio stack so a game can trigger its own sounds.

modules.name: Aver.Audio.Scene
modules.description: The join between the mixer and a live scene: reverb zones and occlusion probes.
modules.consequence: No reverb zones or audio occlusion in a scene.

modules.name: Aver.Audio.Sdl
modules.description: Linux and macOS audio output device that feeds the mixer.

modules.name: Aver.Audio.Wasapi
modules.description: Windows audio output device that feeds the mixer.

modules.name: Aver.Camera
modules.description: Spring-arm camera rigs on scene entities: collision, lag, look-ahead, blended view targets, FOV and the modifier stack.
modules.consequence: Games keep the fixed third- or first-person boom: no camera collision, lag, blends, modes or camera modifiers.

modules.name: Aver.Core
modules.description: Foundation library every other module stands on.

modules.name: Aver.Deform
modules.description: Sub-bone vertex deformation: a cage finer than the skeleton.
modules.consequence: Meshes can only be posed by bones; no sub-bone cage deformation.

modules.name: Aver.Fabric.GDExt
modules.description: Hosts Godot GDExtension plugins (.gdextension) of a converted project: the interface, a minimal engine class registry and the aver_gdext C ABI.

modules.name: Aver.Fluids
modules.description: The analytic Gerstner water surface, the underwater fog override and soft-body fluid volumes.
modules.consequence: No water surface, underwater fog or fluid volumes.

modules.name: Aver.Formats
modules.description: Readers and writers for the engine's asset formats; also hosts the audio and material format targets.

modules.name: Aver.Formats.Godot
modules.description: Reader for Godot 4's text formats (.tscn, .tres, project.godot, .import, .gdextension) for the Fabric converter.

modules.name: Aver.Formats.Particles
modules.description: The .ocparticle reader and writer.
modules.consequence: Particle effects cannot be loaded from or saved to .ocparticle files.

modules.name: Aver.Formats.Roslyn
modules.description: The Roslyn backend for actor scripts.
modules.consequence: Actor scripts fall back to the built-in scanner.

modules.name: Aver.Framework
modules.description: Gameplay vocabulary over the scene: game instance, game mode, actors, pawns.
modules.consequence: No game instance, game mode, actors or pawns; gameplay has no framework to stand on.

modules.name: Aver.Hair
modules.description: Strand hair authoring: the .ochair groom, the procedural generator, glTF curve import, collision proxies and the settings builder that drives Jolt's Hair.
modules.consequence: No strand hair: grooms cannot be generated, imported from curves or built into a simulation.

modules.name: Aver.Hair.Scene
modules.description: Strand hair on scene entities: the CHair component, groom builds shared between instances, palette and wind feeding, distance cadence and collision proxies.
modules.consequence: Hair components do nothing: no simulated strand hair on characters.

modules.name: Aver.Landscape
modules.description: Chunked heightfield terrain: quadtree, LOD, culling, chunk geometry and its renderer.
modules.consequence: No chunked heightfield terrain.

modules.name: Aver.LevelInstance.Abi
modules.description: Plain-C seam to place, stream and query level instances from scripts.
modules.consequence: Scripts cannot place, stream or query level instances.

modules.name: Aver.Mcp
modules.description: Loopback control channel so a tool can drive the editor (a debugging aid).
modules.consequence: The editor cannot be driven over the loopback control channel and its status-bar widget is gone.

modules.name: Aver.Media
modules.description: H.264 MP4 output for the Movie Render Queue through Windows Media Foundation.
modules.consequence: The render queue cannot write MP4 video.

modules.name: Aver.Nav.Abi
modules.description: Plain-C seam onto polygon navigation maps, the navmesh baker and the A* graphs so Aver.Fabric's navigation nodes drive them.

modules.name: Aver.Net
modules.description: OS sockets (UDP, TCP, IPv4 and IPv6) and a reliable-UDP host/peer protocol with ENet-like semantics, tested on a simulated network.
modules.consequence: A converted Godot project cannot use ENet multiplayer, UDP or TCP sockets.

modules.name: Aver.Net.Abi
modules.description: Plain-C seam onto sockets and the reliable-UDP protocol so Aver.Fabric's multiplayer, UDP and TCP classes drive them.

modules.name: Aver.Occlusion
modules.description: Hierarchical-Z pyramid and two-pass box occlusion culling.
modules.consequence: No occlusion culling; everything inside the frustum is drawn.

modules.name: Aver.Particles
modules.description: CPU and GPU simulated particles (sprites, ribbons, mesh particles) with a module stack and spawn-at-event, depth-tested against the scene.
modules.consequence: No particle emitters or particle rendering.

modules.name: Aver.Physics
modules.description: Jolt rigid bodies, characters, joints, queries and its plain-C ABI.
modules.consequence: Nothing collides or falls; characters cannot move.

modules.name: Aver.Physics.Jolt
modules.description: The vendored Jolt library that Aver.Physics is built on.
modules.consequence: No rigid-body backend; goes with Physics.

modules.name: Aver.Platform
modules.description: Windowing, files, directory watching and other OS services.

modules.name: Aver.Prefab
modules.description: Prefab instances in a live world: spawn, overrides, revert, apply, plus their C ABI.
modules.consequence: No prefab instances.

modules.name: Aver.RHI
modules.description: The device-neutral rendering interface and its null device.

modules.name: Aver.RHI.D3D11
modules.description: DirectX 11 rendering backend.
modules.consequence: No DirectX 11 renderer.

modules.name: Aver.RHI.D3D12
modules.description: DirectX 12 rendering backend (primary).
modules.consequence: No DirectX 12 renderer; the engine falls back to another backend or the null device.

modules.name: Aver.RHI.D3D12.ImGui
modules.description: The Dear ImGui implementation of the editor UI seam on DirectX 12; also needs AVER_ENABLE_UI.
modules.consequence: The editor UI cannot draw on DirectX 12.

modules.name: Aver.RHI.Vulkan
modules.description: Vulkan rendering backend (headers vendored; no SDK needed).
modules.consequence: No Vulkan renderer.

modules.name: Aver.RHI.Vulkan.ImGui
modules.description: The Dear ImGui implementation of the editor UI seam on Vulkan; also needs AVER_ENABLE_UI.
modules.consequence: The editor UI cannot draw on Vulkan.

modules.name: Aver.Ragdoll
modules.description: A skinned entity's skeleton as a physics ragdoll, blended over the animation.
modules.consequence: Skinned entities cannot go limp or be driven as ragdolls.

modules.name: Aver.Render.ActorPreview
modules.description: The actor editor's offscreen preview renderer.

modules.name: Aver.Render.Denoise
modules.description: The FidelityFX-based denoiser and its host code.

modules.name: Aver.Render.Hair
modules.description: Draws strand hair: the compute host that runs Jolt's hair simulation on the GPU, and the camera-facing ribbon pass with its strand-count levels of detail.
modules.consequence: Strand hair is simulated but not drawn.

modules.name: Aver.Render.NeuraFI
modules.description: Neural frame interpolation.

modules.name: Aver.Render.Neural
modules.description: Small neural networks that run inside the frame (MLP inference and training).

modules.name: Aver.Render.PBR
modules.description: Material library, its plain-C ABI and the surface BRDF.
modules.consequence: No material system or surface BRDF; materials cannot be authored or rendered, and Voxi cannot be built.

modules.name: Aver.Render.PathTracer
modules.description: The reference path tracer and its scene view.

modules.name: Aver.Render.Pcg
modules.description: The GPU half of procedural content generation.

modules.name: Aver.Render.Skin
modules.description: GPU skinning for skinned meshes.

modules.name: Aver.Render.SoftBody
modules.description: Draws cloth and destructible pieces whose vertices come from simulated soft bodies.
modules.consequence: Simulated cloth and destructibles are not drawn.

modules.name: Aver.Render.Sr
modules.description: The upscaler implementations behind the IUpscaler seam.
modules.consequence: No upscaler; rendering is at native resolution only.

modules.name: Aver.Render.UI
modules.description: The GPU half of the retained game UI.

modules.name: Aver.Render.Voxi
modules.description: Voxel GI, ray tracing and path tracing render features with their settings and C ABI.
modules.consequence: No voxel GI, ray-traced lighting or path tracing; the frame uses the plain raster path.

modules.name: Aver.Runtime
modules.description: The engine object that creates the device and owns the frame loop.

modules.name: Aver.Save
modules.description: Turns a live world into a .ocsave and back.
modules.consequence: Worlds cannot be saved or loaded as .ocsave files.

modules.name: Aver.Scene
modules.description: Entity and component world: entities, transforms, hierarchy and the plain-C ABI.
modules.consequence: No entities, components or world; everything built on the scene goes with it.

modules.name: Aver.Scripting.Host
modules.description: In-process .NET scripting host (hostfxr/CoreCLR) and the managed bridge.
modules.consequence: No C# scripts or script graphs run; actors have no script logic.

modules.name: Aver.Settings
modules.description: Durable key/value store for a shipped game.

modules.name: Aver.SoftBody
modules.description: Cloth and destruction topology: cage, damage, tear islands and the .ocsoft asset that drives Jolt soft bodies.

modules.name: Aver.SoftBody.Scene
modules.description: Cloth and destructibles on scene entities over Jolt soft bodies: dents, tearing, detached pieces, wind.
modules.consequence: Cloth and Destructible components do nothing: no wind-blown cloth, dents, tearing or breaking pieces.

modules.name: Aver.Sound
modules.description: A .ocsnd node graph rendered to PCM or played in real time.

modules.name: Aver.Synapse
modules.description: Navigation and pathfinding on a grid; no scene needed.

modules.name: Aver.Synapse.Abi
modules.description: Plain-C seam onto steering, crowds, hearing, cover and squads.
modules.consequence: Scripts cannot reach steering, crowds, hearing, cover, squads, queries or smart objects.

modules.name: Aver.Synapse.Gpu
modules.description: GPU crowd-avoidance backend.

modules.name: Aver.Synapse.Scene
modules.description: The join between the pathfinder and a live scene: agents, perception, behaviour trees.
modules.consequence: No AI agents, perception, behaviour trees, state trees, environment queries or smart objects in a scene.

modules.name: Aver.Trifactor
modules.description: Virtualized-geometry cluster builder and LOD DAG (meshlets).
modules.consequence: No virtualized-geometry cooking (meshlets, LOD DAG).

modules.name: Aver.UI
modules.description: Retained game UI: widget tree and draw list; not the editor's ImGui.

modules.name: Aver.UI.Abi
modules.description: Plain-C seam onto the game UI so a HUD is authored in the game's language.

modules.name: Aver.Upgrade
modules.description: Project migration chain: upgrade a project from the version it was made in.
modules.consequence: Projects made by an older engine version cannot be migrated when opened.

modules.name: Aver.Vehicle
modules.description: The .ocvehicle asset, the vehicle spec, the built-in presets and the builder over the physics vehicle ABI: cars, trucks and tanks.
modules.consequence: No .ocvehicle assets, no Vehicle component and no AI traffic cars.

modules.name: Aver.Vehicle.Scene
modules.description: Cars, trucks and tanks on scene entities over Jolt's vehicle constraint: engine, gearbox, differentials, driver aids, wheel visuals, telemetry, driving and crash damage.
modules.consequence: The Vehicle component does nothing: no drivable cars, trucks or tanks, no telemetry and no driver seat.

modules.name: Aver.World
modules.description: Turns .ocworld placements into entities and streams regions; shared by editor and game.

planned.name: Aver.ABI
planned.description: Dropped: a single flat C seam was rejected; each module keeps its own plain-C ABI.

planned.name: Aver.Aero
planned.description: Planned: baked aerodynamic sampling and force application.

planned.name: Aver.Match
planned.description: Planned: matchmaking protocol codec and match forming.

planned.name: Aver.NetVehicle
planned.description: Planned: vehicle replication, damage and crash replay.
